extra_key: - `{key}` is not a key of the shape asked.
empty_text: - `{key}` must not be empty when `no_view` is false.
figure_fields: - For this question `implied_outcome.low` and `implied_outcome.high` are numbers and `implied_outcome.yes_no` is null.
event_fields: - For this question `implied_outcome.yes_no` is true or false and `implied_outcome.low` and `implied_outcome.high` are null.
direction: - `direction` must be one of {allowed} for this question.
outcome_label: - `outcome_on_due_day` must be one of this question's rung labels: {labels}.
unknown_item: - `{item}` is not an item id in the packet.
duplicate_question: - question {question_id} is answered more than once.
decisive_too_many: - `decisive_items` must list at most 6 distinct item ids; it lists {count}.
decisive_duplicate: - `decisive_items` must not repeat an item id.
question_out_of_range: - `{question_id}` is not one of the questions asked (c01 to c15).
